source.name: Crystal Palace FC: Temporal expands Crystal Palace partnership to become front-of-shirt partner of Palace Women
source.quote: Crystal Palace Football Club are delighted to announce that Temporal will expand its partnership with the Club to become the new front-of-shirt partner of Crystal Palace Women.
source.note: The same announcement says: 'Temporal’s logo will now also feature prominently on the front of Palace Women’s matchday shirts'.

source.name: Crystal Palace FC: Crystal Palace Women announce TEN Ltd as new shirt sleeve sponsor
source.quote: TST Foundation and its affiliated NYSE-listed energy transport company TEN Ltd will continue their partnership with the Club, with TEN becoming the team’s official shirt sleeve sponsor.
source.note: The same announcement says the logo will 'feature on the sleeve of the home, away and third kits'. The club's photos of the home match against Tottenham on 20 Sept 2026 (https://www.cpfc.co.uk/news/match-reports/report-palace-women-defeated-at-selhurst) show the white home shirt with Temporal on the front and TEN on both sleeves, and no sponsor on the back of the shirt or on the shorts.

summary: Temporal is on the front of the white 2026/27 home shirt and TEN is on both sleeves (club announcements of 9 and 16 Sept 2026). The club's photos of the home match against Tottenham on 20 Sept 2026 show no sponsor on the back of the shirt or on the shorts.
